Specification: This module defines a very small wrapper specification for a memory system by instantiating another module named InternalMemory with parameters mem, ctl, and buf. It extends MemoryInterface and defines an operator Inner that is an INSTANCE of InternalMemory, then defines Spec existentially over the instance parameters and refers to the instantiated specification ISpec. The file contains no state variables, no actions defined locally, and no explicit temporal properties beyond the top-level Spec expression that delegates behavior to the instantiated module.
